Subject: Vendor master initiation — Barnes & Co. (tax docs, remittance & PO routing)

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for agreeing to start the vendor setup for Barnes & Co. We need a few items to create your supplier master record and configure PO routing/remittance. If you can get these back by end of week it will let us process the first PO on the next cycle.

Required items (quick checklist):
- Legal/business name exactly as registered
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or VAT/Tax country ID if non-US)
- W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN / local tax form (if applicable) — PDF please
- Remittance contact name + email (where AP invoices should be sent)
- Banking details for payments (ACH preferred): bank name, account number, routing number, account holder name. If you prefer wire, please indicate SWIFT and beneficiary details.
- Billing address and tax address (if different)
- Primary operational contact for POs (name, phone, email)

Attached is our Supplier Onboarding Form (spreadsheet) that collects the above — filling the form is the quickest path. Also attach a voided check or bank letter if you are providing ACH details.

Note on purchase orders: Redwood requires a valid PO number on invoices for net-30 settlements. If Barnes prefers to operate without POs for small one-off engagements, let me know and I can route for an exception, but that will slow payment.

Attachments: Barnes_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (fillable)

Next steps: send the completed form + W-9 and either a voided check or bank letter. If you have internal questions about which tax form applies, copy AP at ap@barnesco.com and I will loop in our tax team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

- PO exceptions: Procurement requires POs by default. For <= $500 we can approve ad-hoc invoices without a PO if AP flags them as "non-PO small spend" — set vendor profile field 'PO required' = Yes and add an internal flag for 'small spend tolerance' so AP can process quickly.
